meta.tagline: AI-powered intelligent vehicle service centre management

hero.headline: One platform that sees every bay, every vehicle and every risk.
hero.summary: AutoSense connects four AI components on a shared event bus to cut waiting time, assess damage, forecast service duration and protect each customer's vehicle while it is in the service centre.

components.name: Bay Occupancy & Queue Prediction
components.summary: Detects which service bays are free or busy and predicts customer waiting time.

components.name: Vehicle Damage Assessment
components.summary: Finds visible damage on arriving vehicles and estimates its severity.

components.name: Predictive Maintenance & Duration Forecasting
components.summary: Forecasts how long each service job will take, using inspection findings.

components.name: Vehicle Security & Disaster Detection
components.summary: Protects each customer's parked vehicle: detects fire, smoke, weapons, unauthorised access, tampering and loitering, then alerts the right people by severity.

events.name: bay.state
events.description: Live bay map: which vehicle is in which bay and its job status.

events.name: inspection.report
events.description: Damage findings used as forecast inputs.

events.name: job.forecast
events.description: Expected completion time feeds the queue forecast.

events.name: security.alert
events.description: Threat, severity, affected vehicle/people and who to notify.

steps.title: Vehicle arrives
steps.text: Component 2 inspects the vehicle and records visible damage.

steps.title: Job is forecast
steps.text: Component 3 predicts how long the service will take.

steps.title: Bay and queue are managed
steps.text: Component 1 assigns a bay and updates waiting times.

steps.title: Vehicle is protected
steps.text: Component 4 watches the vehicle until pickup and raises graded alerts.
